description: Phase 4 question extraction fixture: raw continuous speech (lowercase, no punctuation) and the questions to extract. See ARCHITECTURE §5.2.

cases.input: hi thanks for joining can you hear me okay great so how does bgp choose the best path

questions.text: how does bgp choose the best path

cases.note: Greeting, audio check and filler come before the real question.

cases.input: how does bgp pick a path what about ospf and how would you troubleshoot a flapping session

questions.text: how does bgp pick a path
what about ospf
how would you troubleshoot a flapping session

cases.note: Three questions with no punctuation.

cases.input: what is an sli and how is it different from an slo

questions.text: what is an sli and how is it different from an slo

cases.note: Compound question: the second part depends on the first, so it stays whole.

cases.input: we run payments on aks with about forty nodes how would you plan the upgrade

questions.text: how would you plan the upgrade

ignored.text: we run payments on aks with about forty nodes

cases.note: Statement is context for the question.

questions.text: tell me about a time you handled an outage

cases.note: Request, not an interrogative.

cases.input: so um yeah okay
cases.note: Only filler: nothing to answer.

cases.input: what is an error budget how do you alert on burn rate

questions.text: what is an error budget
how do you alert on burn rate

when would you use a startup probe

cases.input: how would you design the ledger for

questions.text: explain the tls handshake
how mutual tls differs
